payload.title: Markus citations: match gatsby-citation-manager output exactly (real CSL formatter, verified against live)
payload.description:
Live anth.us renders references with gatsby-citation-manager: <Citation data={CSL-JSON}/> inline + <CitationsList citationFormat="apa"/>, formatted by Citation.js (citeproc-js + the CSL APA style). Papyrus PR #83 added the equivalent model to Markus ([@key] inline, front-matter citations: CSL-JSON, ::citations{format="apa"}), but formats with a HAND-ROLLED APA formatter that has never been diffed against live (epic item F; known weak spot: several people in one author string).

Goal: Markus citation output (inline marker markup + bibliography markup and text) matches the live site for all 25 bibliographies / 201 markers / 197 entries in the corpus. Approach: diff every page against the verified production build (/Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-live/public, = live), then replace the hand-rolled formatter with a real CSL processor (citeproc-py) using the same APA CSL style file Citation.js bundles, so formatting matches by construction. Keep scope to what the corpus uses (YAGNI). Exception: live numbers some citations 0,0,0 due to a gatsby-citation-manager bug; keep our correct 1,2,3 and document it. Pilobol.us must stay byte-identical (it does not use citations; prove it).
